problem:
The Taylor series for the function $f(x)$ about $x=-2$ is given by

$$
f(x)={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{(-1)^{n+1}{2}^{2n+1}}{(2n)!}(x+2)^{n}.
$$

Calculate the first three non-zero terms of the Taylor series expansion about $x=-2$ of ${f}^{′}(x).$

${f}^{′}(x)=$
{{field-1}}
$\,-\,$
{{field-2}}
$(x+2)\,+\,$
{{field-3}}
$(x+2)^{2}+⋯$
